def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0)
    color = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in points); c0 = min(c for r, c in points)
    shape = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in points]
    mh = max(r for r, c in shape) + 1; mw = max(c for r, c in shape) + 1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
